# ResolveIntersections: objects merge properties (intersecting their types),
# numbers intersect to integer, and of several arrays the first one's items
# are dropped (TypeScript quirk: allOf [integer[], string[]] is string[]).
builder prov
prim i integer
prim d double
str s unrestricted
prim b bool
prim nul null
obj o1 x:i,y?:s - n=O1 desc=first
obj o2 y?:s,z:b - n=O2 desc=second
inter objs o1,o2 n=Objects
union iu i,s n=IntOrString
union du d,b n=DoubleOrBool
inter nums iu,du n=Numbers
arr ai i
arr as s
inter arrs ai,as n=Arrays
arr ab b
inter arrs3 ai,as,ab n=ThreeArrays
cls top o:objs,n:nums,a:arrs,a3:arrs3 n=Top
top Top top
finish printonrewrite
print
resolve debug
flatten
gc
print

# Additional properties: kept if every member has them, otherwise dropped
# and the attributes are lost.
builder prov
prim i integer
str s unrestricted
prim any any
obj m1 a:i s n=M1
obj m2 b:s any n=M2
inter both m1,m2 n=Both
obj m3 c:i - n=M3
inter some m1,m3 n=Some
cls top b:both,s:some n=Top
top Top top
finish
resolve debug
print
resolve  # string & integer of property c is impossible: an empty union
print
